body: Market lens: useful household buffer ito, pero timing shift siya more than removal of the underlying energy shock. Keeping fuel support through October can soften the near-term hit to consumers and measured pump prices; part of the burden is instead carried by public spending. Kaya November ang cleaner test. If crude/yen pressure stays unfavorable and support rolls off, household inflation can reappear; if support keeps being extended, the fiscal cost becomes more relevant. INFERENCE lang—hindi pa evidence ng either outcome.
